mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, password FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.user_no, u.user_id, u.password, u.user_name, u.email, u.phoneNumber, u.ip, u.signup_date, u.account_status, r.rank_name, u.workplace, u.jobtask, p.position_name, c.company_name AS companyName FROM users u LEFT JOIN title t on t.user_no=u.user_no LEFT JOIN rank r on t.rank_no=r.rank_no LEFT JOIN position p on t.position_no=p.position_no LEFT JOIN company c on c.company_no=u.company_no WHERE u.user_no = #{userNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT t.user_no, r.rank_name AS rankName, p.position_name AS positionName FROM title t LEFT JOIN rank r ON t.rank_no = r.rank_no LEFT JOIN position p ON t.position_no = p.position_no WHERE t.user_no = #{userNo}
SELECT status_no AS statusNo, status_name AS statusName, icon FROM status

SELECT user_no AS userNo, is_alarm_on AS isAlarmOn, allow_event_invitation AS allowEventInvitation, allow_attendance_response AS allowAttendanceResponse, allow_task_assignment AS allowTaskAssignment, allow_task_completion AS allowTaskCompletion FROM ALARMSETTING WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE ALARMSETTING SET is_alarm_on = #{isAlarmOn}, allow_event_invitation = #{allowEventInvitation}, allow_attendance_response = #{allowAttendanceResponse}, allow_task_assignment = #{allowTaskAssignment}, allow_task_completion = #{allowTaskCompletion} WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inquiry WHERE user_no = #{userNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
